title: SolQvia Device Model / Region / Carrier Variant Database
scope: Domestic carrier sales, Japan open-market models, iPhone regional model-number maps, and selected current cross-region primary-source comparisons.
safety_rules: A shared product name does not prove identical hardware, SIM layout, radio bands, FeliCa, VoLTE/IMS or regulatory status.
Band overlap is not a carrier operation guarantee.
For imported devices, confirm the exact hardware model number and Japanese regulatory conformity before purchase/use.
Do not infer eSIM or physical-SIM support from another region variant.
